lines: The article reader now renders every part of a post faithfully — all images (not just the first), embedded notes and profiles as rich cards, code blocks with their language, and inline videos and audio — while keeping the text fully selectable for highlighting.
Search now opens pasted Nostr event and profile identifiers directly, and long articles render reliably to the end.
Tapping 'Open room' from a profile's Communities tab now navigates to the room properly instead of dismissing immediately.
Introduced What's New — you'll see updates here after each release.
